sloka: तस्मान्न लक्ष्मणे रामः पापं किञ्चित्करिष्यति ।रामस्तु भरते पापं कुर्यादिति न सं शयः ॥२-८-३२॥
transliteration: tasmānna lakṣmaṇe rāmaḥ pāpaṁ kiñcitkariṣyati ।rāmastu bharate pāpaṁ kuryāditi na saṁ śayaḥ ॥2-8-32॥

translations.english: Rama will do no harm to Lakshmana. As for Bharata, Rama will doubtless do him harm.
